title: Scalar restriction identifies the single proper and open reduction generators
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$, $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Schemes are separated finite type over $k$, with their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Put $\widehat R_T=\lim_n(A_n)_T$. Use the strict semilinear system category $\mathscr S_T$, reduction $\mathcal R_T$, total limit $\mathcal L_T$, and actual unit and counit of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Let $\mathcal T_T=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\ge1}^{op},\operatorname{Mod}(\underline R_T))$ and use its derived category, strict reduction $\mathcal R_T^{\mathcal T}$ and total limit $\mathcal L_T^{\mathcal T}$ of [lem-sf-cbc-compact-support-composition-limit]. Let $U_T:D(\mathscr S_T)\to D(\mathcal T_T)$ be exact termwise restriction along $\underline R_T\to(A_n)_T$, and let $H_T$ be restriction along $\underline R_T\to\widehat R_T$, an equivalence on complete objects [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence].

Take either a proper map $p:V\to T$ and $A=S_p$, or a quasi-compact open immersion $j:V\hookrightarrow T$ and $A=J_j$, with the simultaneous section operations of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Let $M$ be a derived-complete constructible integral complex on $V$; require its input and output systems to have compatible etale-origin witnesses and normalized reductions with cohomological and finite Tor amplitudes in common finite intervals, exactly as in [lem-sf-generator-reduction-coherence]. Let $A_{\rm int}$ be integral proper direct image in the first case and localized completed-ring open extension in the second [lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison]. Let $r_{A,M}:\mathcal R_T(A_{\rm int}M)\to A\mathcal R_VM$ be the specified basic coefficient comparison of [lem-sf-generator-reduction-coherence]. On constant coordinates put $A_c=Rp_*$ or $J_j^c=C_TJ_j$ respectively, and $\widetilde A=R_p^{\mathcal T}$ or $J_j$. Here $C_T=\mathcal L_T^{\mathcal T}\mathcal R_T^{\mathcal T}$ has its quotient-tower completion unit. Let $q_{A,HM}$ be precisely the one-letter comparison of [lem-sf-cbc-compact-support-composition-limit]: the diagram-site counit-tensor projection map for proper direct image, or the completed-open comparison defined by reduction of the completion unit.

Use the canonical derived scalar-restriction identifications $U_TA\cong\widetilde A U_V$, and $\rho_M:U_V\mathcal R_VM\cong\mathcal R_V^{\mathcal T}H_VM$, induced by the single strict quotient diagram and tensor reassociation. Identify $H_TA_{\rm int}M\cong A_cH_VM$ by the canonical proper direct-image scalar comparison, respectively the completed-open identification fixed by the completion unit. Then the two maps from $U_T\mathcal R_T(A_{\rm int}M)$ to $\widetilde A\mathcal R_V^{\mathcal T}(H_VM)$ are equal:
$$ (\widetilde A\rho_M)\circ(U_TA\cong\widetilde A U_V)\circ U_T(r_{A,M})
 =q_{A,H_VM}\circ\rho_{A_{\rm int}M}.$$
The scalar-restriction operation comparisons intertwine the units and counits of the proper inverse-image/direct-image and open-extension/restriction adjunctions, with inverse image the exact termwise inverse image of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. The identifications and the displayed equality are natural in the derived strict-tower category, including the quotient transitions. No compactification-composition comparison is asserted.
